name: Md Anisul Islam
title: Technical Lead | Senior Software Engineer
professionalSummary: Technical Lead and Senior Software Engineer with 7 years of experience across the full arc of product engineering, from zero-to-one builds to scaling regulated production systems. Operated across healthcare AI, cybersecurity, IoT, and e-commerce, consistently working at the intersection of architecture, delivery, and cross-functional leadership. Comfortable owning complex systems end-to-end, making defensible architectural decisions under constraints, and bridging the gap between executive product vision and engineering execution. Strong practitioner of AI-assisted engineering workflows, with a proven instinct for setting the right delegation boundaries, task granularity, and review checkpoints to maximise speed without letting quality drift. Hands-on by default; managerial by necessity.
